title: Extend Introductions with Interaction Demonstrations
description: Extend the introduction (tour) system so interaction-gated steps (advance: action/utility/tool) show a visual demonstration, not just a text hint. While the user's real cursor is idle (~1.6s), mute it and play an animated ghost cursor performing the gesture (left click, right click, double click, drag, scroll) at the target. Any real cursor movement stops the demo instantly and restores the real cursor; re-idling replays from the beginning. Targets must be addressable by element id (+ normalized offset), absolute/normalized screen coords, absolute/normalized window-local (pane) coords, and 3D scene world coords projected through the live camera. Add Rust types (IntroductionPoint, IntroductionGesture, IntroductionCursor, IntroductionDemonstration) under framework/core/rs/lib.rs's Introduction region, regenerate TS bindings, build the demo playback engine in ui/js/react/index.tsx (idle hook, point resolver, rAF gesture timeline, ghost cursor styled from the real cursor SVGs), a 3D scene-point projector bridge in framework/renderer/react/index.tsx's WorldCanvas subtree, wire demonstrations into all five interaction-gated steps of the Aggregator brand (mit-bestand/aggregator/brand.ts), and extend existing test files (no new test files) with Rust serde round-trips and ui-react vitest coverage.
summary: Extended the introduction (tour) system with ghost-cursor gesture demonstrations. Added Rust types (IntroductionPoint, IntroductionGesture incl. Orbit, IntroductionCursor, IntroductionDemonstration) with a `demonstrations: Vec<IntroductionDemonstration>` field on IntroductionStepDefinition supporting ordered multi-gesture sequences (looping). Built the ui-react playback engine: idle-detection hook tracking the real pointer's last position (so demos travel from the user's actual cursor, not a fixed offset — fixed a reported duplicate-motion bug where appear/travel animated the same range twice), a point resolver covering element/screen/window (absolute+normalized) and 3D-scene targets, an orbit arc (quadratic bezier) distinct from straight-line drag, a scroll/zoom bob-and-ripple visual, and an automatic "click Next" demonstration for purely-informational steps so brand authors don't have to spell it out per step. Added a react-three-fiber scene-projector bridge in the shell for 3D targets. Wired all six interaction-gated Aggregator brand steps plus a new zoom→pan→orbit sequence on the viewport step. Fixed two pre-existing missing `ts_rs::TS` derives in ui/wgpu/rs/lib.rs (StyleSpec, UiExternalSlotNode) that were blocking typegen for unrelated concurrent work. Root-caused and fixed a runtime crash: brand.ts's five plain "Next"-only steps lacked the new required `demonstrations` field (TS type-only, not caught by Vite's dev transform) — confirmed via a live dev-server repro and fixed by adding explicit `demonstrations: []`/arrays to all 11 brand steps; typecheck now confirms this class of error. Verified via Rust unit tests, framework-core generate/check, ui-react and framework-renderer-react vitest suites, and a live browser walkthrough (ghost cursor correctly targets the Next button and plays the viewport's multi-gesture sequence).
